This cleanser does an excellent job of removing dirt, oil, and makeup without stripping my skin of its natural moisture. I have normal to combination skin, and I noticed that it balances my skin beautifully. After using it, my face feels clean but not tight, which is a huge plus. I love that it contains Glycolic Acid and essential ceramides. The Glycolic Acid helps with gentle exfoliation, while the ceramides work to maintain the skin barrier. After a few weeks of use, I've noticed a significant improvement in my skin's texture and clarity. It feels hydrated and looks more radiant. I also appreciate that it's suitable for daily use, making it a versatile addition to my skincare routine. Overall, I highly recommend the CeraVe Balancing Air Foam Cleanser for anyone looking for a gentle yet effective cleanser. It's a fantastic product that delivers on its promises, and I will definitely repurchase it!
